headline: Tyson Foods Announces Quarterly Dividend
summary: SPRINGDALE, Ark., Aug. 06, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- The Board of Directors of Tyson Foods, Inc. (NYSE: TSN), at a meeting on August 6, 2026, declared a quarterly dividend of $0.51 per share on Class A common stock and $0.459 per share on Class B common stock, payable on December 15, 2026, to shareholders of record at the close of business on December 1, 2026. headline: Are Wall Street Analysts Bullish on Tyson Foods Stock?
summary: Tyson Foods may have trailed the S&P 500 over the past year, but Wall Street isn't ready to give up on the stock, with analysts remaining moderately optimistic about its recovery prospects.
